title: More Happy Than Not
author: Adam Silvera
current_text: In May 2022 a panel of 18 people recommended that More Happy Than Not by Adam Silvera remain in the school district's libraries, after a conservative group complained to the PCPS superintendent that it was among 16 books that contained pornography or were harmful to children. The panel was split on the grade level at which it should be available.
